summary: Tested Wallet i18n (EN/JA/AR), regional Intl formatting, GeoCurrencyPrompt deep-link, and backend ledger bucket sync/reconcile/withdraw guard. All 6 backend tests pass. UI verified in all 3 locales after fixing a small hero-balance bug (BalanceValue hardcoded '$') that leaked raw USD on the wallet hero. GeoCurrencyPrompt fires correctly on a listing deep-link with a fresh browser context (fr-FR → suggests EUR), and choice persists.

minor.issue: `bucket` field is stored in Mongo but stripped by WalletTransaction Pydantic model on serialization. Server-side reconcile still works (reads Mongo directly), but frontends cannot distinguish frozen vs available tx rows without inferring from `type`. Consider adding `bucket: Optional[str] = None` to WalletTransaction.

ui_bugs.issue: Fixed during testing: hero available/frozen balance was rendered via BalanceValue which hardcodes `$${value.toFixed(2)}`, causing raw USD ($52.50) to appear on the wallet page in JA/AR/INR modes while surrounding tx amounts were correctly localized. Fix wraps the value with useCurrency().format before passing to BalanceValue (which already accepts strings).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add `bucket: Optional[Literal['available','frozen']]` to WalletTransaction Pydantic model so frontends can visualize which bucket a tx belongs to (server reconcile is unaffected).
Consider extending the hero-balance formatter fix to BalanceValue itself (accept a formatter fn) so this class of drift can't recur in future callers.
critical_code_review_comments: BalanceMask.BalanceValue fallback branch hard-codes '$' + toFixed(2). This is a landmine: any component that passes a raw number will silently render USD regardless of active currency. Recommend removing the number-branch or requiring a formatted string.
WalletTransaction pydantic model doesn't surface `bucket` — the payload contract diverges from the persisted document. Consider a `model_config = {extra: allow}` or explicit field.
GeoCurrencyPrompt is correctly mounted OUTSIDE <Routes> in App.js so it fires on any deep-link. Confirmed working with a fresh fr-FR context on /listing/:id.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo data. Admin reconcile idempotent (delta≈0 on second call).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet i18n now complete across EN/JA/AR + INR/JPY/AED formatting via Intl.NumberFormat. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/wallet_ja_fixed.png and wallet_ar_fixed.png. Backend ledger bucket sync verified: audit endpoint OK, admin reconcile idempotent, self-reconcile OK, withdraw-overdraft returns 400. GeoCurrencyPrompt data-testid='geo-currency-prompt' confirmed to appear on deep-link /listing/:id in a fresh context and persists via mrc_geo_currency_prompt_dismissed + mercari_currency in localStorage.
rca_of_the_issue: Hero balance leaked USD in JA/AR: Wallet.jsx passed a raw number to <BalanceValue value={data.balance}>, and BalanceValue's fallback branch stringifies it as `$${n.toFixed(2)}` — hard-coded dollar sign, ignoring active currency. Root cause: BalanceValue predates the new i18n formatter wiring and was not migrated. Mitigation applied: wrap value with useCurrency().format() before passing, which BalanceValue accepts as a string on its first branch.
